segments.ja379:1.1: Kākolā kākasaṅghā ca, mayañca patataṃ varā [vara (ka.) mayantipadassa hi visesanaṃ];
segments.ja379:1.3: Sabbeva sadisā homa, imaṃ āgamma pabbataṃ.
segments.ja379:2.1: Idha sīhā ca byagghā ca, siṅgālā ca migādhamā;
segments.ja379:2.3: Sabbeva sadisā honti, ayaṃ ko nāma pabbato.
segments.ja379:3.1: Imaṃ nerūti [nerunti (sī. syā.)] jānanti, manussā pabbatuttamaṃ;
segments.ja379:4.1: Amānanā yattha siyā, santānaṃ vā vimānanā;
segments.ja379:4.3: Hīnasammānanā vāpi, na tattha vasatiṃ vase [vasatī vase (syā.), vasa divase (pī.)].
segments.ja379:5.1: Yatthālaso ca dakkho ca, sūro bhīru ca pūjiyā;
segments.ja379:5.3: Na tattha santo vasanti, avisesakare nare [nage (sī. syā. pī.)].
